name: Oath-keeper Senna
bio: Reads the oaths of the stones in Oathstones. Knows which ones swear Kinship, Form or Prism.

portrait.subject: a cute young fantasy stone-whisperer with short teal hair, a robe embroidered with gem symbols and several glowing coloured stones orbiting her hands
portrait.background: ancient stone circle at dusk with glowing runes

request: Senna, oath-keeper of Oathstones. The stones whisper your name. Friends? 🔷
hello: The stones approve. They hum when they're happy.
Every stone keeps its own oath. Listen to them.
about: I'm Senna. I read the oaths of stones. Kinship stones match by colour, Form stones by shape, Prism stones only when every colour differs.
how: A match-3 RPG where each token keeps its own oath (rule for matching). Learn the oaths and use them to win battles.
tips: Read each stone's oath before you swap.
Prism lines are rare but powerful.
Form stones ignore colour. Look for shapes!
chat: A Motley stone told me a joke. I didn't get it.
I sorted stones by oath. Took all night.
A Kinship stone cried when its family matched.
nudge: The stones have a new challenge for you.
A battle stirs at the circle. Come?
idle: The circle waited {ago} for its oath-taker.
progress: Level {level}! The stones listen to you now. 🔷
update: Oathstones updated to v{version}. New oaths whisper.
